name: Pirate Raiders
description: Seafaring scoundrels moving in a ravaging pack.

abilities.name: Horde (1d4+1)
abilities.description: When the Raiders have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead.

abilities.name: Swashbuckler
abilities.description: When the Raiders mark 2 or fewer HP from an attack within Melee range, the attacker must mark a Stress.
